def edit_distance(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    m, n = len(a), len(b)
    prev = list(range(n+1))
    cur = [0]*(n+1)
    for i in range(1, m+1):
        cur[0] = i
        ai = a[i-1]
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            cost = 0 if ai == b[j-1] else 1
            cur[j] = min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j-1] + 1, prev[j-1] + cost)
        prev, cur = cur, prev
    return prev[n]

def binary_search(a, target):
    l, r = 0, len(a) - 1
    while l <= r:
        m = l + r >> 1
        if a[m] == target: return m
        elif a[m] < target: l = m + 1
        else: r = m - 1
    return -1

description-en: Least significant digit radix sort
code:
def radix_sort(a):
    def get_max(a):
        m = a[0]
        for v in a:
            if v > m: m = v
        return m
    def count_sort(a, exp):
        n = len(a)
        out = [0] * n
        count = [0] * 10
        for v in a: count[(v//exp)%10] += 1
        for i in range(1, 10): count[i] += count[i-1]
        for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
            idx = (a[i]//exp)%10
            out[count[idx]-1] = a[i]
            count[idx] -= 1
        return out
    m = get_max(a)
    exp = 1
    while m // exp > 0:
        a = count_sort(a, exp)
        exp *= 10
    return a

description-zh: Boyer-Moore 字符串匹配（坏字符规则）
description-en: Boyer-Moore string matching with bad character rule
code:
def boyer_moore(text, pattern):
    n, m = len(text), len(pattern)
    if m == 0: return 0
    bad_char = {}
    for i, c in enumerate(pattern): bad_char[c] = i
    shift = 0
    while shift <= n - m:
        j = m - 1
        while j >= 0 and pattern[j] == text[shift+j]: j -= 1
        if j < 0: return shift
        c = text[shift+j]
        shift += max(1, j - bad_char.get(c, -1))
    return -1

import threading, time

class TokenBucket:
    def __init__(self, rate, burst):
        self.rate = rate
        self.burst = burst
        self.tokens = float(burst)
        self.last_update = time.time()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def allow(self):
        with self.lock:
            now = time.time()
            elapsed = now - self.last_update
            self.last_update = now
            self.tokens = min(self.burst, self.tokens + elapsed * self.rate)
            if self.tokens >= 1:
                self.tokens -= 1
                return True
            return False

description-en: Lock-free FIFO ring buffer
code:
import ctypes, threading

class RingBuffer:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.buffer = (ctypes.c_int * capacity)()
        self.read = 0
        self.write = 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def push(self, v):
        with self.lock:
            if self.write - self.read >= self.capacity: return False
            self.buffer[self.write % self.capacity] = v
            self.write += 1
            return True

    def pop(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.write <= self.read: return None, False
            v = self.buffer[self.read % self.capacity]
            self.read += 1
            return v, True
